document:
Remove Tony Blairs Knighthood., This does not need many words. 

Tony Blair being awarded a Knight Hood is an absolute disgrace and a shows a complete lack of respect for the 179 brave British souls that paid the ultimate sacrifice whilst serving in Iraq whilst he was Prime Minister.   ALL FOR WHAT?
Reverse the decision to award Tony Blair, ex Prime Minister, a Knighthood, Stop the Knighthood award.

Create a law that requires unnecessary lighting to be turned off, Create a law that requires lights in shop window displays to be turned off at 1am. Interior lights in offices and other non-residential buildings should be switched off an hour after the last employee leaves.

Freedom for unvaccinated patients to undergo fertility treatment, Make it illegal to mandate vaccination as a compulsory action for fertility patients. This should apply to the public and private clinics.
Make it unlawful for shops to refuse cash payments., Make it illegal for retailers and services to decline cash payments.

Recognition of natural post-Covid19 immunity as vaccines exemption, Natural immunity is how humanity survived and adapted to the environment over millennia. Its efficacy, durability and adaptability is the gold standard to which pharmaceuticals aim to compare with. Historically, NO treatment is offered to a person AFTER they recovered from their illness.

Make titles 'Dr', 'Ms', 'Mr' and 'Mx' the only options on official documents, Remove all other titles - including 'Miss’, 'Mrs' and ‘Master’ where they are currently used on official documents - so the only options are 'Dr' for people with a doctorate, 'Ms' for females, 'Mr' for males and 'Mx' for non-binary people. We believe this will make options equal across all genders.

Make keeping birds in cages illegal, We believe it's far too normalised to keep a bird in a cage, often with other birds. I've seen birds in cages in various stores and it shouldn't be legal. It's not necessary to cage birds, just for the entertainment of humans.

Ban the sale of cats and dogs online and increase penalties, The Government should ban the sale of cats and dogs online. These animals are being stolen at an alarming rate for selling on. Online classified ad platforms have thousands of cats and dogs listed for sale. Some are surely stolen animals in a poor state.

Reverse all pay rises for MPs for the last 10 years., I want the Government and Parliament to reverse all pay rises for MPs for this year and the last 10 years because they are mismanaging our economy and making everyone else pay for their mistakes. It is unfair.

Introduce neonatal leave and pay entitlement immediately , The government has agreed to introduce neonatal leave and pay entitlement but not until April 2023, this is completely unacceptable & it needs implementing immediately.
 
Our baby was born in June 2021 at just 24 weeks gestation, he wasn't due until October,  he was 16 weeks early.

Introduce new requirements for breeders and sellers of cats and dogs, The Government should introduce the following requirements:
 
- Every cat and dog microchipped before sale
- Mandatory registration for all breeders
- All sales to be registered by deed
- New owners required to register their ownership

Stop work places having two tier sick pay for unvaccinated employees, If an unvaccinated individual is isolating due to catching COVID and a vaccinated individual has to isolate for the same reason they should receive the same sick pay and not be discriminated against over vaccination status.

Evidence of Immunity Post-Covid infection to be accepted for employment, Health and Social Care employees should be offered the opportunity to demonstrate their serological evidence of post-infection immunity as an alternative to vaccination status for employment purposes. This will reduce the forecasted staffing crisis and increase levels of trust.

Allow victims of domestic abuse to apply for ILR from outside the UK, The Government must take action to tackle the problem of transnational marriage abandonment, by allowing victims of domestic abuse to apply for ILR from outside the UK.
A bill to ensure that defecting MP's resign, triggering an automatic byelection, To pass a bill to make defectors to other parties resign, triggering an automatic byelection in their Constituencies.

free sia top up course or be able to complete online., make the top up course free or available to do online.we are one of the lowest paid industries and to find around £270 and take 3 days of work is ridicolous plus a badge top up fee of £190 ,this should be a course online for free ,we already have the ACT course online ,is this not enough
Make it a legal requirement for drivers to stop & report collisions with cats, Amend legislation to make it a legal requirement for a driver to stop & report accidents involving cats.
Reverse the changes to the highway code, Abolish the new changes to the highway code as they are dangerous

Increase maximum penalty for an adult carrying a knife to 7 years in prison., Currently the maximum penalty for an adult carrying a knife is 4 years in prison and an unlimited fine. You’ll get a prison sentence if you’re convicted of carrying a knife more than once. Change this offence to 7 years in prison on first offence of carrying a knife.

Reverse the National Insurance hike and replace it with a wealth tax., Have a parliamentary debate and vote on replacing the National Insurance hike with an increased wealth tax on the UK’s richest citizens.

Call for general election following government parties during lockdowns, I call on a national general election to have a say in who runs this country. This is gollowing all the revelations of parties in various government buildings during regional and national lockdowns.

Extend Bereavement Support Payments to unmarried couples who cohabit, I believe in the modern society we live in there should be the same bereavement payment entitlement for unmarried couples as there are married couples.

Introduce a fast-track divorce procedure for victims of domestic abuse, Victims of domestic abuse need to go through the same divorce process as everyone else. This can be time-consuming, costly and traumatic.

The Government should implement a fast-track process for victims of domestic abuse to get a divorce, to ensure victims can legally separate from their abuser.

Make reversing cameras mandatory on all HGVs., Alot of articulated lorries do not have reversing cameras fitted. It's impossible for a driver to see what is behind the vehicle especially on a blind side reverse. Resulting in many serious and fatal accidents.

Abolish all COVID-status certification in the United Kingdom, We want the Government to abolish domestic and international COVID-status certification. 

Due to high vaccination & booster uptake, continued relaxation of restrictions, and fast approaching endemicity of coronavirus, it is neither right nor proportionate to continue certification in Britain.

Change Female Genital Mutilation (FGM) in law to Female Genital Cutting (FGC), I am a British citizen who survived Female genital cutting back in Somalia. The name Female Genital Mutilation is not a name that all victims and survivors relate to, and in fact being labelling mutilated can contribute to a victim's mental health and insecurities. We aren’t mutilated.

Abolish domestic COVID-status certification in the United Kingdom, We want the Government to abolish all domestic COVID-status certification remaining in use.

Due to high vaccination & booster uptake, continued relaxation of restrictions, and fast approaching endemicity of coronavirus, it is neither right nor proportionate to continue such measures in Britain.

Give employees a right to full pay during sick leave, The Government should give employees a statutory entitlement to full pay when they are off sick, for at least the first several weeks of sickness, in line with entitlements in many other countries. Many employees are only entitled to £96.35 per week in Statutory Sick Pay (SSP). This is not enough.

Offer second boosters to every person over 50 or clinically vulnerable, Second boosters/fourth doses must be immediately offered to every person over 50 or clinically vulnerable. Ideally this should be offered around 4 months after the first booster/third dose. Walk-in vaccinations are needed to facilitate this rollout throughout Spring.

Stop referring to the UK State Retirement Pension as a 'Benefit', We demand that the State Retirement Pension be referred to as State Pension Entitlement and for any use of the word 'Benefit' to be deleted from the Pension system!

Require workplaces offer women paid menstrual leave, Introduce law that requires companies offer paid menstrual leave to all their female employees. This should be at least a couple paid days off a month, so they can recover from potentially agonising menstrual symptoms.
Require police offer victim support to all victims of pet theft, Pet theft is on the rise and owners are victims of crime and should be offered Police Victim Support.
Ensure equality in sport, Ensure that governing bodies allow competitors in womens sport are born female. Transgender athletes who identify as women have an advantage due to genetics

Create pension parity for men and women born before 1951/53, The Govt must increase state pension for men/women born before 6 April 51/53 to the same as those born after these dates. The gap of £2.5k between old/new state pensions is an absolute scandal. I missed the new pension by 14 days costing me £2.5k a year. This disparity has led to pauper pensioners.

Provide free sanitary products to shops for the homeless community., The government should fund shops such as Morrisons, Tescos, Boots, Superdrug etc to give free sanitary products to homeless people so they have access to tampons, pads and menstrual cups. They should have whatever type they desire. Long pads, short pads, non-applicator tampons, scented products etc.

Amend the Equality Act so asexuality is an orientation, intersex as a sex., Section 11 of the Equality Act (2010), does not include intersex people which we believe it should.
Section 12 of the Equality Act (2010), does not include asexual people which we believe it should.

Require domestic cats be kept indoors at all times, We are a family who enjoy outdoors, and love our garden. However due to local cats coming and using our garden as a toilet, we spend a lot of time cleaning up after them. We want all domestic cats to be required to be kept indoors at all times, to prevent inconvenience to others.

Provide maternity leave and pay for pregnancies terminated after 20 weeks, Currently eligibility for statutory maternity leave and pay only begins after the 24th week of pregnancy if the baby is not born alive. Maternity entitlements should be offered to parents in situations where a pregnancy is terminated after the 20-week scan for medical reasons.
To reverse the recent decision to provide calorie content on menus, To reverse the enactment of calorie disclosure on menus in restaurants and other public food vendors menus

Limit details of non-molestation orders being shared with perpetrators, I am asking for only summary points to be given to a perpetrator of domestic abuse when being served with a non-molestation order, to help to minimise more harm or suffering for the victim

Boris Johnson and Rishi Sunak - hold them accountable for breaking the law, The positions of responsibility these two law breaking Ministers hold completely undermines any integrity of the British parliamentary system. I call for their immediate suspension, and that their suitability to hold positions of responsibility and power be reviewed as a matter of urgency.

Fund 3 rounds of IVF for all couples who cannot conceive naturally, NICE guidelines state if you are a woman aged under 40 you should be offered 3 full cycles of IVF if you have been trying for more than 2 years. Yet CCGs set their own criteria which means IVF is not offered to many couples, including where they or their partner already have a child.

Make female hormone health a compulsory part of the curriculum starting age 10, The Government should add the following mandatory content to the Health Education curriculum:
- The role of hormones on overall bodily functions at KS2
- Sex hormones and reproductive health, inc. menstrual cycle, fertility, different methods of contraception (pros and cons) at KS3

Decommission the domestic NHS COVID-Pass, We want the Government to completely abolish the domestic NHS COVID-Pass from the NHS app. It is no longer right or proportionate to retain these measures considering the majority of COVID restrictions are removed. Britain has a highly vaccinated population displaying antibodies against SARS-CoV-2.

Legislate against rogue &cowboy traders. Ensure financial refund for victims, Rt Hon Kwasi Kwarteng MP to review the legislation to ensure it is a criminal offence to take money and not complete work agreed. The courts have power to seize property of Company Directors their employees who had knowledge of the scam/ theft and their personal partners to repay victims a lump sum

Make the private slaughter and consumption of cats and dogs illegal, We claim to have some of the highest levels of animal welfare, yet the private slaughter and consumption of cats and dogs is actually LEGAL in the UK so long as it is done ‘humanely’!

Require foetal scanning to be offered all women prior to an abortion, The Government should require all women to be offered a scan prior to an abortion, particularly women who are having a medical abortion at home, where evidence of the gestational stage of the foetus is not known, nor circumstances, which can lead to dangerous and tragic complications.

Ensure domestic abuse survivors are better protected by CMS post-review, The Government should ensure that domestic abuse (DV) survivors are better protected by the Child Maintenance Service (CMS) following the recent Independent Review of Child Maintenance Service (CMS) Domestic Abuse Operational Policies & Procedures.

Introduce a legal minimum requirement for hamster cages., The government needs to introduce minimum legal requirements for hamster cages to stop pet shops and other retailers from being able to sell inadequate, unsuitable cages. Hamsters need a bare minimum of 4000cm2 and many pet shops sell cages much much smaller than this causing unnecessary suffering.

Ban school uniforms in sex shops and pornography, We urge the Government to make it illegal for school uniforms to be displayed and sold within sex shops to stop the sexualisation of children. We also think it is vital for pornography to ban displaying videos where school uniforms are worn as a costume.

Ban isolation as a punishment in schools., Isolation can be used for mild things, such as not wearing a tie that is meant to be worn as part of school uniform. Other schools give students a full-day of isolation for getting “too many” detentions in one day, even after completing the full-day of isolation, they still have to complete reflects
Stop the ban on tethering birds of prey, Stop defra's proposed ban on tethering birds or have birds of prey except from the new rules.

End mandatory coalition in the Northern Ireland Executive, It is time to overhaul how the executive is formed in Northern Ireland. Mandatory coalition does not work. We have moved on from 1998 and it is time to end rules that distribute ministerial posts to multiple parties representing different communities. It is time for change.

Make the spaying and neutering of pet cats a legal requirement, Females that have not been spayed are more likely to get cancer and get pregnant over and over again. Unneutered males wander for miles in search of females so run the risk of getting lost, accidents, fights with other males and being injured which can cause infection. Many shelters are full.

Appeal The Decision That Stops The Importation Of Dogs From Overseas, We want the government to overturn their decision that now means dogs and cats commercially travelling (rescue animals) from Romania, Ukraine, Belarus and Poland cannot be brought into the UK. This ruling means many reputable rescues can no longer re home dogs or cats in the UK.

Stop paying salaries to parties that refuse to form a Assembly at Stormont., MLA’s continue to be paid, despite not having a sitting assembly over one parties protest over the NI protocol. This is unacceptable, MLA salaries from parties that refuse to form an assembly should cease until a negotiation has been reached and a sitting Northern Irish Assembly has been restored.

Legally recognise genders such as Non-binary, Genderqueer and Intersex, Not everyone fits into the bracket of male or female, and our laws are outdated and prevent acceptance of diversity. I know people who have had to go out into the world and be confronted with the fact that their gender is not legally accepted. I cannot describe how offensive and damaging that is.

Require drivers of motorcycles for paid work to have full licence for type, We want the Government to require anyone who drivers a moped or motorbike for work to be required to have the full licence for the type of vehicle they drive. We believe it is unacceptable and unsafe that such drivers can operate with only a provisional licence and a CBT certificate.

Add more Bull Terrier type dogs to the Dangerous Dogs Act, American Bully's and Staffordshire Bull Terriers are by far the breed of dog which is in the news on such a regular basis for seriously injuring or killing children. It is completely unnecessary and can be solved so easily by adding these to the banned list.
Reverse recent changes to the ministerial code , Reverse changes to the ministerial code made in May 2022. We believe these changes reduce politicians' accountability to Parliament and the public.

Change section 170 of the road traffic 1988 adding cats on the list, Changing the 170 section of the traffic act of 1988 and adding cats onto the list of Animals hit in an RTA that drivers must notify police/vets etc and help ASAP helping save that Cats life

Ban the sale of rabbits in shops rescue only, Ban the sale of rabbits in pet stores they should be rescue only like cats and dogs , there’s so much suffering and cruelty as people can buy them on a whim and no nothing about how to care for them .

Make it illegal to refuse to employ or dismiss a person based on their tattoos, Make it so that employers can't fire existing employees or refuse to hire future ones because of a tattoo. The only legal exception to the rule should be if the tattoo depicts or endorses inappropriate or discriminatory behavior.

Increase penalties for knife crime offences, We want the Government to increase the penalties that apply to knife crime offence, to help keep our streets and cities safe. We believe current penalties, and stop and search, doesn't adequately tackle knife crime.

Increase penalty for driving whilst using a phone to a driving ban for all, Currently the fixed penalty for driving while using a mobile phone is 6 points and a £200 fine. If you are taken to court you can receive a fine of up to £1,000 (£2500 for Lorry and Bus Drivers), and be banned from driving. We propose anyone driving while using a phone face an automatic driving ban.
Ban advertising and sale of domestic pets online, The sale and advertising of domestic pets to be banned on internet sites

Allow the flying of Suffrage flag as a symbol of women's equality, Since its introduction in 1908, the Suffrage flag of the Women's Social and Political Union has attained iconic status as a symbol of women's equality. Catalogued under WOA T52 of the Parliamentary Collection, it deserves the same legal recognition granted to e.g. the Rainbow and NHS flags.
Fund free chicken pox vaccinations for all children, The Government should fund free chicken pox vaccination for all children.

Grant full citizenship to British citizens by descent, and their children, The Government should allow British citizens by descent who have lived in the UK for over 5 years to ‘upgrade’ their status to full citizenship, and automatically grant their children citizenship if they were born abroad.

More funding and a better system is needed for our Mental Health, As Mental Health crisis' are becoming more known of and many people getting failed by the system I want the Government to fund and create a better system for people's Mental Health. 6 weeks of therapy is what is offered by the NHS, this is nowhere near enough to even adhere any change.

Deport convicted refugee criminals who have abused our laws in the UK., Keep us safer by removing convicted criminals of serious crimes that have been welcomed to the UK only for them to break our laws. How are they able to just renounce their original countries and stay?

Change how social services and CAMHS deal with child mental health, Change how social care deal with cases where a young one enters into self harm or suicidal ideation, when parents can explain. To be listened to and not looked into as a possible cause when no evidence is shown and parents work well with education and other agencies to support the child.

Require all public buildings to install gender-neutral bathrooms

 , There are many non-binary/questioning/demi-genders within the UK and they find it difficult to choose whether to use a male or female bathroom. We need gender neutral toilets and bathrooms with just cubicles and sinks so that those that do not identify as either male of female feel comfortable.

Male circumcision should be made illegal to under 18s unless for medical reasons, Circumcision should be made illegal to children under 18 years old unless for medical emergencies, the practice of parents circumcising their young children who are in no position to consent is violates human rights principles. I hope the government can review their policy on this.
Give employees a right to two days paid leave a year for religious observations, Make it law for employees of all faiths to be allowed two days paid leave a year for religious observation.

Remove penalty points from minimum penalty for speeding, I would like the Government to remove penalty points from the minimum penalty for speeding. Currently the minimum penalty for speeding is a £100 fine and 3 penalty points added to your licence. We believe the minimum penalty should just be a fine, and not penalty points.

Allow employees to claim unfair dismissal after probation, Employees who have been dismissed can only claim for unfair dismissal if they have been in their role continuously for two years or more (except for automatically unfair reasons).

Make socio-economic status a protected characteristic in the Equality Act, Protection from discrimination on the basis of socio-economic status should be added to the Equality Act. Social status is currently not protected under the Equality Act.

Make legal aid available to all parties in family courts cases about children, When there are legal proceedings in the family court regarding one or more children, I would like the Government to make legal aid available to all parties, to ensure everyone has sufficient representation and one side is not at a disadvantage.

Grant automatic UK citizenship to those born to a British mother before 1983, Grant automatic UK citizenship to people who were born before 1 January 1983 to a British mother. Only those born to a British father before that time were automatically British citizens, which also means that their descendants may miss out on entitlements to British citizenship.
Ensure clear labelling on donated blood., To ensure donated blood, used for transfusions etc, is clearly labelled to say whether it is from a donor who has had the covid 19 vaccination or not.

Make child abusers and child murderers ineligible to appeal sentences, The Government should stop people who have been convicted of child abuse or child murder from being able to appeal their sentence. The children they abuse or worse still murder cannot change what has happened to them, so those convicted of these offences should not be able to appeal their sentence.

Stop courts being able to grant care orders based on risk of future suffering, We believe current laws on removing children from parents are outdated and unjust. Currently a court can grant a care order removing children from their parents if they are 'likely to suffer harm'. This can mean children can be removed even if they have come to no harm. We believe this is wrong.

Reinstate reproductive rights in statement on religion, belief & gender equality, The UK Government has quietly removed women's reproductive rights from the Statement on freedom of religion or belief and gender equality. Please reinstate reproductive health and rights as a commitment in this statement, to be protected and upheld.

Make it compulsory for Restaurants and Cafes to have a Baby Changing Facility, Make it a legal requirement for Cafes and Restaurants to have a baby changing facility. To have either a designated changing room itself and/or to have a male and female toilet with suitable facilities to change. Too many times there is either no facility or it is just in the women's.

Require schools offer all sports the school offers to children of any sex, We want schools to be required to allow children of any sex to play any sport that the school offers to children of one sex. Why does gender come into the sport you are offered or able to do?

Introduce legal requirement for annual licensing on each domestic cat ownership, An annual renewable licence for each cat with the requirement to;
Microchip 
Owners to have responsibilities for damage to gardens and property caused by their cat.
Keep cats indoors at night (Curfew) 
Prosecution for damage to birds and nests (Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981)

Amend the Equalities Act 2010 to include menopause as a protected characteristic, To help keep more women in the workplace for longer and to improve their rights I want the Government to add menopause to the Equalities Act 2010 as a protected characteristic, and require employers to make reasonable adjustments for menopausal women.

Remove gender and sex markers from government documents (other than healthcare), The Government should remove what I feel is an unnecessary requirement to declare gender and/or sex on Government documentation, including passports and other forms of photographic identification such as driving licences.

Request Her Majesty's pardon for those who were executed for Witchcraft in 1612, We call on the Government to request Her Majesty to pardon the 10 innocent people convicted and hanged for Witchcraft at the Lancashire Witch Trials of 1612, Pendle Hill. This was was a political and religious persecution, a pardon is long overdue & should be granted.

Require swimming venues to maintain single-sex or private changing facilities, In the context of new policies introduced by swimming venues allowing biological males who identify as women to access female facilities we believe the Government must protect women's access to swimming by ensuring access to safe single-sex or private changing facilities.

Stop the sale of live animals in pet stores & require them to link with rescues., Lucy's Law (2020) means that pet shops cannot sell kittens or puppies. It is still legal to sell rabbits, mice, birds, guinea pigs & many other equally sentient animals.  The law needs to be widened to include all animals currently bred for sale in shops & to oblige all stores to promote rescues.

Amend the dangerous dogs act to protect domestic animals when a dog escapes, The Dangerous Dogs act should be amended to add protections for other pets and their owners when a dog is dangerously out of control and the owner could have prevented it. If a dog has escaped its owner, and harms another domesticated animal, the dog's owner should be liable for that.

I want the Governement to Limit or prohibit the use of nitrous oxide cannisters., Children and young adults are abusing nitrous oxide to the point they are blacking out and crashing cars, ending up in comas or paralysed. It is heart-breaking and soul destroying watching this happen.

Automatically remove parental responsibility from domestic abusers, We want the Government to automatically remove parental responsibility from parents who have been found to have committed domestic abuse. This should apply if someone is convicted of a domestic abuse offence, or where a family court finds that domestic abuse has taken place.

Update the Equality Act to make clear the characteristic “sex” is biological sex, The Government must exercise its power under s.23 of the Gender Recognition Act to modify the operation of the Equality Act 2010 by specifying the terms sex, male, female, man & woman, in the operation of that law, mean biological sex and not  "sex as modified by a Gender Recognition Certificate"
Introduce mandatory neutering for domestic cats and dogs., We ask the Government to make neutering mandatory for domestic cats and dogs, except for animals belonging to licensed breeders.

Fully outlaw practice of landlords/agents refusing to let to benefits claimants, Fully commit to stopping the practice of estate agents and landlords being able to refuse you on the basis of getting housing and other benefits.

Create a new Ancestors Bank Holiday, We want the Government to make the 3rd Monday of September a bank holiday in the United Kingdom, in recognition of all whom we have known and have now passed from this life. This new Bank Holiday shall be known as Ancestors day.

Parental care 50/50 in seperation cases, and make parental alienation a crime., To change the law, or pass legislation which makes it a presumption in law that parental care will be shared 50/50 in separation cases, unless impractical or evidenced risk of harm exists Also to make parental alienation a criminal offence under domestic abuse or child abuse legislation.

Create a national register of perpetrators of domestic abuse, I would like the Government to create a national register with details of all people who have been convicted of domestic abuse offences. This should cover physical abuse, mental abuse, emotional abuse, coercive control.
Stop for cats, I want you to make it a legal requirement for people to stop when a colison has happened involving a cat and make it a legal requirement to report it
Ban all disposable plastic bags., Please completely ban disposable plastic bags from shops and supermarkets and replace them with a paper alternatives at a reasonable price to the customer.
Form an emergency coalition Government, We call on the Government and Parliament to form an emergency Government made up of MPs representing all political parties, and MPs who are independent.

Reverse IR35 legislation
 
, The Government had announced that reforms to the off-payroll working rules (also known as IR35) would be repealed from 6 April 2023, but this decision has been reversed by the new Chancellor.
Throw Rishi Sunak out of parliament, Remove Rishi Sunaks status as an MP, throw him out of parliament

Make swift bricks compulsory in new housing to help red-listed birds , Swifts have declined by over 50% in the UK. Adult swifts, known for site-fidelity, return to the same nests. We want swift bricks to be required in all new housing, to provide homes for these birds. Surveys show these are used by red-listed swifts, house martins, starlings and house sparrows.
Make female sterilisation available on demand to all women, I want the Government to give women the right to be sterilised as and when they want to be, without having to fight for this.

Make mandatory for cats to be neutered and chipped before allowed to roam., Cat owners who wish for their cats to roam outside must take the responsibility to neuter and microchip all owned cats; with valid registration, before letting cats roam outside the confinements of the home, to help reduce the number of unwanted pregnancies, and to help reunite found missing cats.

Prevent the removal of Trans rights protections in 2010 Equality Act, Under the Equality Act currently, the law protects all trans people regardless of whether they have a gender recognition certificate affirming their gender and there is no requirement to have undergone medical transition. We would like Rishi Sunak to keep these protections in place for trans people.

Increase penalties and fund increased enforcement for river pollution, We want the Government to amend legislation governing offences for polluting rivers, from industrial or agricultural sources, and fund increased enforcement action against polluters.
Include transgender people in the Equality Act, Reconsider scrapping transgender people from the equality act
Do not remove gender reassignment from the equality act, Do not go forward with proposed plans to remove gender reassignment as a protected characteristic from the equalities act

Ensure transgender rights are not gutted from the 2010 equality act, Allies in solidarity with the trans community want members of parliament to defend and protest against the proposal of transgender rights to be legally "gutted" from the equality act under recent anti trans pressure. Members of parliament must act on commitments made in the 2010 equality act.

Mandatory carbohydrate information on all menus for those with type 1/2 diabetes, Make carbohydrate information mandatory on ALL foods and food establishments including restaurants, takeaways etc to assist those with type 1/2 diabetes. Food allergy info is mandatory to prevent fatalities and so should carb information to enable diabetics to administer correct insulin amount.

Stop Rishi Sunak removing Trans peoples rights from the Equality Act 2010, By removing the legal protection  for Transgender people in the UK. This means Trans people will no longer be able to safely access same-sex spaces.
Discrimination will be legal too in the workplace. This is putting so many Trans people at risk!

Leave the current equality act unchanged for transgender inderviduals., Leave the 2010 equality act as it is. Allowing the transgender community to still have access to emergency spaces of their identifying gender, help and continue to protect against discrimination as well as continue to protect individuals with and without a gender recognition certificate.

Commit to not amending the Equality Act's definition of sex, It has been reported that the Government may amend the Equality Act to "make it clear that sex means biological sex rather than gender." The Government has previously committed to not remove legal protections for trans people, an already marginalised group, but this change would do so.

Introduce automatic comprehensive restraining orders for domestic abuse offences, Currently, when someone is convicted of a domestic abuse offence, it is up to the courts whether to impose a restraining order, and any conditions attached. We want comprehensive restraining orders, prohibiting all actions that could cause distress to the victim, made automatic for these offences.

Review the Gender Recognition Act and its interaction with the Equality Act, The GRA enables transgender people to achieve legal recognition in their acquired gender and change their recorded sex. We believe this has had myriad unintended consequences, and the legislation needs to be reviewed to see if it is still fit for purpose, or should be reformed.

Stop the Government from changing gender to sex on the Equality Act, It has been reported that the Government may look to amend the Equality Act to make it clear that sex means biological sex rather than gender, but we want to stop that cause that could put transgender people’s lives at risk when it comes to bathrooms (trans women would have to go to male ones)

Repeal the Gender Recognition Act 2004, We call upon the Government to repeal the Gender Recognition Act 2004. The Act makes it impossible in practice to keep biological men - who are statistically responsible for most violent crime - out of single sex spaces for women.

Do not introduce ID requiring
vaccination for travel or domestic use, Digital and non digital ID requiring vaccination must never be introduced in the UK. It would give the Government power to coerce people into having a medical treatment and discriminate against those who want to exercise their right to bodily autonomy. This medical information must remain private.

Fund research into ACL injuries in women's football, So many female footballer's careers are being ruined due to ACL injuries. They are one of the hardest injuries to recover from. Female footballers are up to six times more likely to suffer an ACL injury than their male counterparts. This is why we need more research into why this is happening.

Remove the ‘right to roam’ status currently applicable to domesticated Cats, Update the law around domestic cats, removing their "right to roam" status, putting the onus on cat owners to take responsibility for any nuisance to, or loss of enjoyment of, land, private property and wildlife. Cats should fall under the same laws applying to dogs and other domesticated animals.

Implement compulsory neutering and spaying of all pet cats., There are millions of stray and feral cats on the UK streets living harsh lives.We therefore now call on the Government to introduce compulsory neutering and spaying of all cats kept as domestic pets.

Allow managed migration of claims for young adults with additional needs., Remove the obstacles in place for young adults with either evidenced, multiple and complex needs or those who are able to show the process will cause significant risk of harm.
Allow those individuals to migrate to their own claims without degrading or harmful processes first.

Legally recognise non binary gender identity., Have non binary be included as an option under the GRP (Gender Recognition Panel)/ GRC (Gender Recognition Certificate), in order to allow those identifying as non binary to be legally recognised as their true gender identity.

Remove the charitable status from private schools to remove tax cuts., Our aim for this petition is to remove the charitable status from private schools. We don’t agree with the underfunding of state schools and believe removing or reducing tax cuts from private schools will benefit funding of state schools.
Ensure that adequate shelter is provided for animals kept outside, To make it a legal requirement that all animals kept outside (farmed and domestic) are provided with adequate shelter.

Stop Gender Recognition Reform (Scotland) Bill, The proposed bill states and allows people in Scotland to self-identify by getting a gender change certificate through an affidavit without medical approval or consultation.

Ban convicted abusers from dating and social media sites and apps, I believe that there needs to be an automatic legal ban on convicted being able to use social media and or dating apps and consequences when failing to adhere to these rules.
